sources.title: Department of the Interior implements emergency permitting procedures to strengthen domestic energy supply
IM 2026-013, Addressing deficiency extension requests when processing applications for permit to drill
Table 12, Time to complete an application for permit to drill, federal and Indian, FY25

status_summary: On 2025-04-23 Interior announced emergency permitting procedures for energy and critical minerals projects under existing NEPA, Endangered Species Act and historic preservation emergency provisions, targeting about 14 days for reviews that would otherwise need an environmental assessment and about 28 days for those needing an environmental impact statement. On 2026-03-17 BLM issued a memorandum on deficiency extensions for drilling permit applications with weekly reporting of pending applications. BLM data show the average federal and Indian drilling permit took 283 days in fiscal year 2025, and no requirement that regional offices match state average permit times was found.

timeline.event: Interior announced emergency permitting procedures for energy and minerals projects with target timeframes of about 14 days (environmental assessments) and about 28 days (environmental impact statements).
BLM issued Instruction Memorandum 2026-013 on deficiency extension requests when processing applications for permit to drill, with weekly reporting of pending applications.

title: Match state average times for Interior rights-of-way and drilling permits
uncertainties: In review the Interior release was re-read: it covers energy and critical minerals projects, sets review targets, does not mention drilling permits or rights-of-way specifically, and makes no comparison to state timelines. BLM Instruction Memorandum 2026-013 was re-read: effective on issuance through 2029-09-30, it allows multiple extensions of the 45-day deficiency period and orders weekly reporting of pending applications; it sets no overall processing target and no state comparison, and allowing extensions does not by itself shorten processing. The BLM processing-time table covers federal and Indian drilling permits only; its date is a month-only date taken from the file path. Public Law 119-21 sections on leasing and permitting and secretarial orders of 2025 were not read. Searches run: Interior emergency permitting April 2025; BLM drilling permit processing times.
